description: Plan v7 section 8.3 fixture family 'owed-m3b-defaultstrings-ladder'. Inputs only; the oracle emits expected.

cases.notes: semanticLanguageRangeForDerivedMatching:2208, the rung where an already-adopted KNOWN identity must not be displaced by a later UNKNOWN one. The semantic range settles on sfb-x-a, whose CLDR fallback chain reaches the sfb catalog; had the ladder kept the original spelling or taken the trailing sgn-be-fx-x-a alias, neither sfb nor sgn would be reachable.
The control: the sfb catalog is loaded and exactly reachable, so whatever the row above answers is about the derived semantic range and not about the catalog being absent.

The JDK's lossy rendering of sgn-be-fr requested directly. Pinning it separately keeps the row above from being satisfied by a port that simply hands the range to Locale.forLanguageTag and matches on the result.
